description: This file defines the MemoryBackend class, a PHP implementation of an in-memory cache backend for Drupal, primarily used for unit testing and specialized cases. It manages cache items stored in a PHP array, with methods for getting, setting, invalidating, and deleting cache entries, as well as handling cache tags and garbage collection.

classes.name: MemoryBackend
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an in-memory cache backend for Drupal, supporting cache operations and invalidation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a time service.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by ID, preparing it if found.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: prepareItem
methods.description: Prepares a cache item for use, unserializing data and checking expiration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item with optional expiration and tags.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple cache items at once.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by ID.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by setting its expiration to the past.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates cache items associated with specific tags.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prevents serialization of the cache object, only serializing the time service.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cache, used mainly for testing.
